blocks.label: Q.1
blocks.notes: Items numbered 1.-5. Answers from Ch 1/Ch 2: community, Van, postman, Teller, hospital. Item 1 is set in a serif font in print (cosmetic).

blocks.label: Q.2
blocks.notes: Option labels mix 'a.' (items 1-3) and '(a)' (items 4-5). Item 1 '1.Where' and item 2 '2.What' have no space after the number. Item 4 'The tool that is used by an electrician is called' has no blank or '?', and option '(d) pliers.' has a full stop; electrician/pliers is not in the Ch 1-2 text (general knowledge; pliers only appears in Ch 3 as a beak analogy). Item 5 option '(b) Bela Ghar' is a misspelling of the textbook's 'Bhela Ghar' (Ch 1); answer (a) Khetala (Ch 1, Sikkim). Keep as printed + teacherNote.

blocks.label: Q3
blocks.notes: Unscramble jumbled words (nearest type one-word; say so in instruction note). Printed 'Q3.' (no dot after Q, unlike 'Q.1'). Item 2 printed 'BAKN -' with a space before the dash. Answers: OTLSAHPI=HOSPITAL, BAKN=BANK, TTESREL=LETTERS, RTAMKE=MARKET. TYPO: 'ROYFLAEV' has 8 letters (extra A) and does not unscramble exactly to FLYOVER (7 letters); keep as printed, accept FLYOVER, teacherNote.

pictures.what: cartoon woman in white coat with stethoscope and clipboard (doctor); pink answer line below
cartoon woman pointing at a green board showing '2+3' (teacher); pink answer line below
cartoon person in red helmet and uniform holding a hose with flames (firefighter); pink answer line below
photo of a colourful children's playground / play structure with slides (a PLACE, not an occupation); no answer line

blocks.notes: Printed 'Q. 6' (space). Only pictures 1-3 show occupations and have answer lines; pictures 4 (playground) and 5 (hay hut, Bhela Ghar) are not occupations and have no lines, yet marks are 1x5. Pictures are unnumbered; number them (1)-(5) left to right. Owner decision needed for items 4-5 (accept the place name, e.g. 'playground'/'park' and 'Bhela Ghar', or a related worker). All 5 must be drawn as SVGs.

blocks.notes: Printed 'Q.7)'; instruction missing 'and' ('Look at the picture answer the questions'). Item 2 '2.What' no space. Item 4 open-ended (cleaning, planting, repairing).

issues: No section letters: one section per printed question (codes '1'-'9', as in sp04); heading = printed question line. Note code '9' is printed Q.10 (no Q.9 exists).
Q.9 is missing (numbering jumps Q.8 -> Q.10). Total still 40, so nothing appears dropped; keep 'Q.10'.
